saw_lines: Fragrance buyers compare every dupe to the designer bottle they already know, then reorder the one that gets compliments.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where the buyer decides whether a dupe is worth it.
Your site shows 14101 reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number. Put the count on every creative and open two ads with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 14101 reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number. Without a count, buyers have no reason to trust a dupe. Put the 14101 count on every creative and open two ads with a review quote.
The site offers 15% off with free shipping, yet 0 of 27 ads mention free shipping. New buyers get no reason to act today. Put 15% off and free shipping in the first line of three new ads.

Your 27 copy ads open with 17 different stories, and the biggest leads 4. Each new opener starts from zero, so nothing builds. Build the batch from the Prime Day opener and the only 3 fragrances opener, and drop the rest.

17 ads have run 60+ days, so they are proven winners. Build three more variations of your oldest, Try It On. Walk Out Smelling Amazing., each naming a store visit and a scent consultation, and keep the original running beside them.

ads_1: Review-led creative with 15% off and free shipping, tested against the bundle opener
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Instagram, your only linked social channel
